title: Prepared groundwater-interface ledger publication owner qualification

finding.statement: groundwater_interface_mass_prepared_t contains only initialized plus generation. Distinct ledgers with the same local generation accept the same prepared-handle value, allowing a foreign handle to authorize irreversible publication on the wrong logical ledger.
finding.required_contract: A prepared publication handle must be bound to the exact ledger reservation that created it, and foreign, stale, copied-after-consumption, or otherwise mismatched handles must fail closed before committed mass or diagnostic state changes.

required_remediation: Bind each prepared handle to an explicit ledger/reservation identity in addition to generation.
Reject foreign or stale handles before commit_prepared or abort_prepared can mutate ledger state.
Preserve O(1) local publication, compact state, exact q action-reaction, and existing counter/generation exhaustion guards.
Re-run O0/O2 runtime-check qualification and all 30 architecture invariants.
Only after owner remediation is green, start a separate independent qualification workunit.
hard_nonclaims: A green blocker-reproduction workflow means the qualification correctly reproduced the defect; it does not qualify the candidate.
No F-GC19R production source is modified by this qualification branch.
No MODFLOW adapter, aquifer solver, end-to-end coupled mass closure, distributed transaction protocol, crash recovery, or throughput qualification is claimed.
next_required_step: Run the exact-head blocker-reproduction workflow. If green, freeze this candidate as blocked evidence and start F-GC19R-R1 owner remediation from the blocked candidate without rewriting this qualification history.
